question: The world's driest desert is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Atacama**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **ATACAMA**

 
 
• It is a desert plateau in **South America (Chile)** and is the** driest non-polar desert in the world**.
 
• It is situated between the **Andes Mountain range** and the **Chilean Coast Mountain range**, covering a distance of 1600 km on the Pacific coast, west of the Andes mountains.
 
• The desert is mainly composed of stony terrain, salt lakes, sand, and lava flowing towards the Andes.
 
• Following are the reasons for the extreme dryness of the desert
 
 
• **Temperature inversion** due to Humboldt ocean current flowing towards the north.
 
• Presence of **strong Pacific anticyclone**.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The Atacama desert is the **only true desert to receive less precipitation than the polar deserts**.
 
• The Atacama desert is the **largest fog desert in the world**.
 
• The soil of the region 100km south of Antofagasta, is compared to the soil present on the **Mars planet**. 
 
• **THAR**
 
 
• It is also known as the **Great Indian Desert** and is situated northwestern part of the Indian subcontinent.
 
• The **majority** portion of the desert **(85%) is found in India** and the remaining part of the desert is found in Pakistan.
 
• In India, the desert spreads across **Rajasthan, Gujarat, Punjab, and Haryana**.
 
 
 
• ​**SAHARA**
 
 
• ​It is the **largest hot desert** found in the **African continent** and **third overall** as it is smaller only than the deserts of Antarctica and the Arctic.
 
• It stretches across - **Algeria, Chad, Egypt, Libya, Mali, Mauritania, Morocco, Niger, Sudan, Tunisia, and Western Sahara**.
 
 
 
• **GOBI**
 
 
• The **cold winter desert** is located in **China and Mongolia**.
 
• It is a **rain-shadow desert**, the **2nd largest in Asia**, and the **6th overall**.
